# ── Per-sample signal computations ──

def compute_sample_sj_scores(instance):

            )

    np.fill_diagonal(matrix, 1.0)
    return [float(np.mean([matrix[k][j] for j in range(N) if j != k])) for k in range(N)]


def compute_sample_surface_scores(instance):
    samples = instance["samples"]
    N = len(samples)
    key_sets = [frozenset(_extract_surface_keys(s, SUBTASK)) for s in samples]
    matrix = np.zeros((N, N))
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(i + 1, N):
            union = len(key_sets[i] | key_sets[j])
            inter = len(key_sets[i] & key_sets[j])
            s = inter / union if union > 0 else 1.0
            matrix[i][j] = s
            matrix[j][i] = s
    np.fill_diagonal(matrix, 1.0)
    fk_scores = [float(np.mean([matrix[k][j] for j in range(N) if j != k])) for k in range(N)]
    return fk_scores, key_sets


def compute_sample_voting_conf(key_sets, N):
    all_keys = set()
    for ks in key_sets:
        all_keys |= ks
    if not all_keys:
        return [1.0] * N
    key_freq = {}
    for k in all_keys:
        key_freq[k] = sum(1 for ks in key_sets if k in ks) / N
    scores = []
    for ks in key_sets:
        if not ks:
            scores.append(0.0)
        else:
            scores.append(float(np.mean([key_freq[k] for k in ks])))
    return scores


def compute_sample_em_scores(key_sets):

    return [counter[ks] / len(key_sets) for ks in key_sets]

        lps.append(lp)
    return lps

    rates = [v / N for v in counter.values()] if counter else [0.0]

        for _ in range(n_boot)
    ])
    alpha = (1 - ci) / 2
    lo = float(np.percentile(boot_means, alpha * 100))
    hi = float(np.percentile(boot_means, (1 - alpha) * 100))
    return lo, hi


def bootstrap_diff_pvalue(a_vals, b_vals, n_boot=N_BOOTSTRAP):
    """Bootstrap p-value for H0: mean(a) == mean(b)."""
    a = np.array(a_vals, dtype=float)
    b = np.array(b_vals, dtype=float)
    obs_diff = np.mean(a) - np.mean(b)
    n_a, n_b = len(a), len(b)
    count = 0
    for _ in range(n_boot):
        a_boot = RNG.choice(a, size=n_a, replace=True)
        b_boot = RNG.choice(b, size=n_b, replace=True)
        boot_diff = np.mean(a_boot) - np.mean(b_boot)
        if abs(boot_diff) >= abs(obs_diff):
            count += 1
    return count / n_boot

    # Claim 2: SJ rho > FK rho
    fk_rhos = [all_seed_results[s]["rho"]["FK"] for s in SEEDS]

    fisher_tests["SJ_rho_gt_FK_rho"] = {
        "claim": "SJ ρ > FK ρ on NER",
        "per_seed_diff": {s: round(sj - fk, 4) for s, sj, fk in zip(SEEDS, sj_rhos, fk_rhos)},
        "all_seeds_consistent": all_positive_sj_fk,
        "mean_diff": round(float(np.mean(diffs_sj_fk)), 4),

    # Claim 3: EM AUROC ranking
    em_aurocs = [all_seed_results[s]["auroc"]["EM"] for s in SEEDS]

    em_vs_others = {}
    for sig, vals in other_aurocs.items():
        diffs = [em - v for em, v in zip(em_aurocs, vals)]
        em_vs_others[sig] = {
            "per_seed_diff": {s: round(d, 4) for s, d in zip(SEEDS, diffs)},
            "mean_diff": round(float(np.mean(diffs)), 4),
            "all_positive": all(d > 0 for d in diffs),

    fisher_tests["EM_AUROC_vs_others"] = {
        "claim": "EM AUROC > all other signals",
        "comparisons": em_vs_others,

        rho_2 = [all_seed_results[s]["rho"][sig] for s in [42, 123]]
        rho_3 = [all_seed_results[s]["rho"][sig] for s in SEEDS]
        two_seed[sig] = {
            "selection_f1_2seed": {"mean": float(np.mean(sel_2)), "std": float(np.std(sel_2, ddof=1))},
            "selection_f1_3seed": {"mean": float(np.mean(sel_3)), "std": float(np.std(sel_3, ddof=1))},

    report_lines.append(f"Seeds: {SEEDS}")

    report_lines.append("")

    # Table 2: Per-seed AUROC

    for sig in SIGNALS:

    report_lines.append("")

    report_lines.append("")
    for test_name, test_data in fisher_tests.items():

    # 2-seed vs 3-seed comparison

    report_lines.append("| Signal | 2-seed F1 (mean±σ) | 3-seed F1 (mean±σ) | CI narrowed? | 2-seed ρ | 3-seed ρ |")

    for sig in SIGNALS:

    print(f"\nAUROC (3-seed mean ± std):")
    for sig in SIGNALS:

        print(f"  {sig}: {r['mean']:.4f} ± {r['std']:.4f}")
